Austin occurs only once, as a descendant of Anna. Tracing upward produces a single connected component whose nodes (ancestors) include (among others):  
Anna, Jennifer, Lori, Frances, Laura, Peter, Lauren, Charles, Nancy, Stephen, Roger, Patricia, Melissa, Scott, Brenda, Sandra, Victoria, Maria, Andrew, Sarah, William, Christina, Steven, Brian, Jordan, Paul, Nathan, Jeffrey, Diane, Walter, Vincent, Joyce, Andrea, Samuel, and Jose, together with their side-branch ancestors (e.g., Elizabeth–Edward–Kyle, Joyce–Vincent–Walter, etc.).

Emma occurs only once, as a descendant of Alice. Tracing upward produces a completely disjoint connected component whose nodes include (among others):  
Alice, Joshua, Charlotte, Christopher, Beverly, Ruth, Danielle, Henry, Katherine, Robert, Martha, Douglas, Harold, Bradley, Carol, Larry, Isabella, Kenneth, Sophia, Nicholas, Randy, Denise, Jason, Julia, Ronald, Debra, Mark, Jeremy, Judith, Barbara, Logan, David, Diana, Kathryn, John, Kayla, Patrick, Donald, Janet, Jacob, Angela, and Adam, together with their side-branch ancestors (e.g., the long chains through Teresa–Aaron, Gary–Catherine, Grace–Benjamin, Amy–Timothy, etc.).

Because no path exists from any node in Emma’s ancestor set to any node in Austin’s ancestor set (and vice versa), the two sets are disjoint:

- Austin is not an ancestor of Emma, nor is Emma an ancestor of Austin.  
- Austin and Emma therefore possess no common ancestor.  
- Austin has no recorded descendants at all, and Emma likewise has no recorded descendants; consequently they share no common descendant.

None of the four stated relationships holds.
